_purpose: Machine-readable fitness for use. Every other file in capri_data describes where an INPUT came from; this one describes how far an OUTPUT can be trusted. It exists so that a caller - a script, a notebook or an agent - can check a result before reporting it, instead of relying on a human having read the prose in README section 9.
_how_to_use: Look up the output you are about to report, most specific key first: 'scenario.permanent_crops' before 'scenario', 'activities.WINE' before 'activities'. Act on 'status': 'validated' needs no caveat; 'use_with_care' should be reported with its note; 'overstated' and 'understated' mean the direction is usable but the level is not; 'not_supported' means the model cannot answer that question and the number should not be used. Absence of a key means no specific finding is recorded - not that the output is validated.

_status_values.validated: checked against CAPRI's own data or against external statistics, and matches
_status_values.use_with_care: usable, but carries a documented caveat that should travel with the number
_status_values.overstated: direction and ranking usable; magnitude is larger than the reference
_status_values.understated: direction and ranking usable; magnitude is smaller than the reference
_status_values.not_supported: the model cannot answer this; the number is an artefact of asking

_generated: 2026-10-27 (refreshed for CAPRI's regional units and the Farm-to-Fork run r161; other entries as of 2026-09-29)

supply.activities.note: 221 regional models, CAPRI's regional units (EU27 215, Norway 6, CAPRI's codes). Farm-to-Fork 2030 on the units (r161, 27 October 2026): every regional solve optimal, NL320000 at JRC121368's relaxed N target (K22). Base crop areas are CAPRI's (166,690 kha).

supply.gross_output.note: Crops from area x yield; livestock from CAPRI's own product coefficients. EU livestock output equals CAPRI's EU27 total.

supply.gross_margin.note: Net revenue x activity levels, livestock revenue from CAPRI's MREV. Responds to policy: organic 25% costs -10.8% of income, the nutrient rule -5.3%.

activities.WINE.note: Every vine-growing region carries a CAPRI price: regional where CAPRI has one, otherwise its country's national price (Italy 1,362, Croatia 1,923, Slovenia 1,858 EUR/t).

scenario.note: Compare on PRODUCTION, as CAPRI reports it, not on area. Must be run to convergence: max_outer_iter=1 gives a partial answer.

environmental.n_surplus.note: EU average 44.5 kg N/ha against a real ~46, with every component independently right: mineral 10.2 Mt (real ~10.8), manure 7.5 (real ~7), crop uptake 13.7. Regional distribution matches CAPRI's SURSOI (median 48.2 against 49.5 over 228 regions).

environmental.n_surplus.IE.note: Irish grass yield is not derivable from CAPRI (its grass price is a dummy and its 'yield' equals revenue), so Irish crop and grass uptake is uncertain and the Irish surplus runs high.

market.prices.note: Base prices reproduce CAPRI's PMRK 12/12; world imbalance 0.003%. Under a policy shock EU prices carry an Armington premium, so they respond to EU supply as CAPRI's do.

market.PARI.note: Rice is a market commodity with CAPRI's world price and FAO balances for 24 regions, but the EU27 base comes from share allocation rather than a FAO row.

projection.note: Validated for a SINGLE step to 2030 against CAPRI's own reference (correlation +0.993, 20 of 23 crops within 25%). A trajectory cannot be validated the way the rest of the model is; report the policy increment separately from baseline drift.

projection.intermediate_years.note: Only the 2030 endpoint has an external reference. Intermediate years solve and return numbers that nothing checks.

projection.livestock.note: Herds are re-optimised each period rather than carried as state, so multi-period livestock paths are not meaningful.

economy_wide.note: Labour, capital and GDP effects are outside the partial-equilibrium boundary, as in CAPRI.

scenario.prices.note: Farm-to-Fork 2030 (r161): cereals +10.7% (CAPRI +8%), oilseeds +14.3% (+11%), vegetables and permanent crops +11.6% (+15%).

market.eu_balance.note: EU production is the model's own output; consumption keeps FAO's EU self-sufficiency. Wheat consumption 99.4 Mt, maize 72.7.

abatement_capri.note: CAPRI's own mitigation portfolio. At full potential, per source, on this model's emissions: enteric CH4 -10.8% (CAPRI max run -12.0%), manure CH4 -22.3% (-21.8%), manure N2O -29.4% (-30.0%). Zero carbon price abates nothing beyond the reference.

abatement_capri.at_carbon_price.note: Price response follows CAPRI's adoption rule for options with published costs; code-defined options (feed additives, diet, ammonia measures) are ASSUMED to follow the same response. Soil N2O uses an EU-wide potential and an estimated per-hectare value.

abatement.note: EcAMPA 2 literature measures, kept as an independent cross-check. Use abatement_capri as the model's estimate.

supply.land_expansion.note: Farm-to-Fork 2030 (r161): total farmland +3.1% against CAPRI's +3% (JRC121368 section 5.1.1). Land rents are CAPRI's per unit and land type (land_rents_2030.csv).

supply.shadow_prices.note: Real duals from the optimality conditions, labelled per constraint row.

supply.landscape_shortfall.note: Unmet landscape requirement in regions whose arable land cannot hold the floor (81.7 kha EU-wide under Farm-to-Fork); CAPRI would convert grassland instead. (measured September 2026, not re-measured on the units; with the land market off see K84)

scenario.livestock.note: Farm-to-Fork 2030 herds (r161): pigs -14.3% (CAPRI -14.5%), beef animals -20.3% (-18%), sheep and goats -10.1% (-9.5%), poultry -12.3% (-16.5%), dairy cows -3.5% (-10%).

regions.nuts2024.note: Results are per CAPRI regional unit. On NUTS 2024 (capri_mod/nuts_reporting) 202 of 217 groups are one unit to one region; in the others (member states without regional detail such as DK, SI, HR; units NUTS later split such as DED00000, PL120000, IT310000; NL31/NL33 and Portugal's 2024 changes; Ireland) each region gets a UAA share of the group's result, not a result of its own. No unit for BE10, DE30, DE50, DE60, ES63, ES64, FRY1-5, NO0B.

water.irrigation.note: Net irrigation requirement (CROPWAT CNIR) on the FSS irrigated area of each unit (capri_mod/water): crop shares are one share per region except rice (CAPRI fits crop shares to FSS crop data not in hand); no irrigation-method efficiency; Ireland and Norway not covered. Base 2017: 11.2 Mha irrigated, 32 km3.

income.regional.note: CAPRI's ProfitAgr form (capri_mod/income): sum of (revenue - input cost + premium) x level per region; distribution across regions only (no farm-level data).
